method: August uses preserved request aggregates. July subtracts August counts for each route in the saved full-period endpoint list. Routes absent from that saved list remain combined under Other / unlisted routes; that bucket reconciles to the complete monthly request and error totals. All time retains the saved route list with its unlisted remainder. Each view shows at most 50 named routes; remaining counts are retained in the combined bucket.
